description: Baseline: pipe-mode throughput across 11 fixtures

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline performance for pipe-mode throughput

description: Larger I/O buffers (4K→16K out, 16K→64K pipeline) - regression

asi.hypothesis: Larger I/O buffers (4K→16K stdout, 16K→64K pipeline stack) reduce syscall overhead
asi.next_action_hint: Try more targeted optimizations: SIMD in ANSI strip, reduce allocations in generic_compact
asi.rollback_reason: Total µs increased from 39K baseline to 44K - larger buffers hurt cache locality

description: New baseline with improved benchmark (p20, 50 runs, 8 large fixtures)

asi.hypothesis: Re-establish baseline with improved benchmark: larger fixtures, p20, 50 runs

description: Baseline with amplified 1MB inputs: 33,892µs total, 102-188 MB/s

asi.hypothesis: Baseline with amplified inputs (~1MB each) to isolate filter throughput from startup overhead. journalctl slowest at 102 MB/s (generic_compact), git_log 150 MB/s

description: Zero-copy lines in generic_compact: skip dupe for ANSI-free lines (-18%)

asi.hypothesis: Zero-copy line slices in generic_compact: skip allocator.dupe for lines without ANSI escapes, reusing slices into the original input buffer

description: Filter-aware benchmark baseline: git_status 34MB/s, git_log 46MB/s, passthrough 105MB/s

asi.hypothesis: Baseline with filter-aware benchmark: git_status slowest at 34 MB/s, git_log 46 MB/s, passthrough 73-105 MB/s

description: Streaming git_status: eliminate buffer, inline dir-grouping (-50% total, 34→72 MB/s)

asi.hypothesis: Single-pass streaming git_status: eliminate intermediate Writer.Allocating buffer, do directory grouping inline with run buffer. Also added first-byte dispatch for section headers and skip lines.

description: First-byte dispatch in git_log applyCompact + isCommitLine - no improvement

asi.hypothesis: First-byte dispatch in git_log.applyCompact and faster isCommitLine (byte-by-byte prefix check)
asi.rollback_reason: No improvement, within noise margin. The switch on line[0] adds an extra branch for most lines.
asi.next_action_hint: Try optimizing the passthrough path or pipeline read performance instead

description: Optimize git_show findDiffStart with indexOf - marginal/neutral

asi.hypothesis: Optimize findDiffStart in git_show.matches() to use std.mem.indexOf for line-start-anchored search instead of line-by-line iteration
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise margin, no meaningful improvement

description: Pipeline: use allocRemaining for large stdin reads (-6%, 180 MB/s passthrough)

asi.hypothesis: Replace streamRemaining with allocRemaining in pipeline.run for large inputs - avoids incremental writer growth

description: First-byte switch in git_diff - regression, icache pressure from large switch

asi.hypothesis: First-byte switch dispatch in git_diff applyInner to skip sequential startsWith checks
asi.rollback_reason: Regression: switch statement generates more code, hurting icache. The sequential checks were already fast because they short-circuit on first byte mismatch.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on reducing allocations in hot paths or binary size optimization

description: 8KB stdout buffer - within noise, not clearly better

asi.hypothesis: Increase stdout write buffer from 4KB to 8KB to reduce write syscalls
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise margin, not clearly better

description: ArenaAllocator in pipe mode - regression, arena overhead wasted

asi.hypothesis: ArenaAllocator in pipe mode to avoid per-alloc syscalls
asi.rollback_reason: Pipeline only does 1-2 large allocations where page_allocator is optimal. Arena init overhead is wasted.

description: Skip stack buffer in pipeline - regression, small input allocations hurt

asi.hypothesis: Skip stack buffer, use allocRemaining directly for all input sizes
asi.rollback_reason: Stack buffer avoids heap allocation for small inputs (<16KB), removing it adds syscall overhead for small data.

description: Stabilized benchmark (50 runs, p10): 17,370µs

asi.hypothesis: Stable baseline with 50 runs, p10. Results are 17-18K range consistently.

description: indexOf-based git_log.applyCompact - regression, line-by-line is faster

asi.hypothesis: Jump to commit markers with indexOf instead of line-by-line iteration in git_log.applyCompact
asi.rollback_reason: Slower: indexOf scans ALL bytes including body text, while line-by-line skips non-commit lines after one byte check. Extra control flow complexity also hurts.

description: SIMD isHex40 - within noise, not enough commit lines to matter

asi.hypothesis: SIMD isHex40 using @Vector(16, u8) to validate 16 hex chars at once
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise. isHex40 called rarely (only for commit lines), 40-byte scalar loop was already fast. SIMD overhead (register setup) > savings.

description: Batch writer calls in git_log applyCompact (-5%, 130→139 MB/s)

asi.hypothesis: Batch writer calls in git_log.applyCompact: combine newline+sha7+space into single writeAll instead of 3 separate calls

description: First-byte guard in git_diff - regression, switch overhead on +/- lines

asi.hypothesis: First-byte guard switch in git_diff metadata drop section to skip startsWith for +/- content lines
asi.rollback_reason: Regression: +/- lines (majority) now go through switch dispatch which is slower than the sequential startsWith that fails on first byte. Also larger code footprint.

description: Early +/- content dispatch in git_diff: skip metadata cascade (-9%, 68→83 MB/s)

asi.hypothesis: Move +/- content line handling before metadata checks in git_diff. These are the majority of lines and now skip the entire startsWith cascade. Context lines and empty +/- are also checked early.

description: Resume session: confirm current standing at 16,150µs

asi.hypothesis: Confirm current best after context reset

description: Bound git_show.matches() diff scan to 8KB (prevents O(n) on git_log data)

asi.hypothesis: Limit git_show.matches() findDiffStart scan to first 8KB. Prevents O(n) scan of 507KB git_log data in pipe mode. apply() still uses full scan for correctness.
asi.note: Marginal - within noise, but avoids worst-case 500KB scan per invocation for git_log pipe data

description: 8KB stdin reader buffer for pipe mode - within noise

asi.hypothesis: Increase pipe-mode stdin reader buffer from 4KB to 8KB to halve read syscalls
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise — the allocRemaining in pipeline already reads efficiently in its own internal buffer

description: Combined parseEntry for git_status - no improvement, already inlined

asi.hypothesis: Combine sigilFor+pathFor into single parseEntry to avoid triple startsWith parsing
asi.rollback_reason: No improvement. sigilFor/pathFor already inlined by compiler. Combined struct return adds code size per switch arm.

description: Pipeline stack buffer 16KB→32KB: sweet spot for cache vs alloc tradeoff

asi.hypothesis: Increase pipeline stack buffer from 16KB to 32KB. Sweet spot: covers most real-world inputs without cache pressure from 64KB. Avoids heap allocation for medium inputs.

description: Fast trim in git_log subject - within noise

asi.hypothesis: Fast trim and byte-level 4-space check in git_log applyCompact
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise — trim and startsWith were already fast enough

description: Single-buffer pipeline read (avoid double alloc+copy) - marginal

asi.hypothesis: Single-buffer pipeline read: pre-allocate 256KB, read directly into it, avoid double-alloc+copy pattern. Marginal but cleaner.

description: Small-input benchmark test: confirms 2.8ms startup floor, reverted

asi.hypothesis: Added small-input tests to benchmark, confirmed startup dominates (~2.8ms). Reverted to original 5 tests.

description: Skip setup check in pipe-mode fast path (-4%, sub-15K first time)

asi.hypothesis: Skip setup.maybeRun in pipe-mode fast path (args.len <= 1). Avoids the function call + arg scanning overhead before the stdin read path. Setup is only relevant for wrapper mode with --setup/--unsetup flags.

description: Defer stderr setup past pipe-mode - regression from stack layout change

asi.hypothesis: Defer stderr writer setup to after pipe-mode fast path
asi.rollback_reason: Regression — moving the stderr_writer declaration changes stack layout and may affect code alignment. No measurable benefit.

description: Defer environ_map - within noise, pointer access is free

asi.hypothesis: Defer environ_map access past pipe-mode fast path
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise — environ_map is a pointer field access, essentially zero cost

description: Final confirmation: 14,367µs (best single run), noise floor reached

asi.hypothesis: Final confirmation run. Consistently 14-15K range. We've hit the noise floor — process startup (~2.8ms) and write syscall overhead dominate.

description: Resume session 3: confirm current standing at 15,917µs

asi.hypothesis: Re-confirm standing after context reset

description: 16KB pipe-mode output buffer: fewer write syscalls (-9%, 195 MB/s passthrough)

asi.hypothesis: 16KB output buffer for pipe-mode only. Reduces write syscalls from ~137 to ~34 for 546KB passthrough. Doesn't affect wrapper mode (still uses 4KB global buffer). Previous 8KB global attempt failed due to cache pressure on wrapper path.

description: 32KB pipe-mode output buffer: 214 MB/s passthrough, 93 MB/s git_diff

asi.hypothesis: 32KB pipe-mode output buffer. Further reduces write syscalls to ~17 for 546KB passthrough. L1 cache is 64KB on Apple Silicon so 32KB fits comfortably.

description: Resume session 4: confirm at 13,894µs

asi.hypothesis: Confirm standing after context reset. Stable ~13.4-13.9K range.

description: 16KB pipe-mode stdin buffer - within noise

asi.hypothesis: 16KB pipe-mode stdin reader buffer to reduce read syscalls
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise. allocRemaining in pipeline uses its own internal buffer growth, so the reader buffer size doesn't matter for throughput.

description: 64KB pipe output buffer - regression, exceeds L1 cache

asi.hypothesis: 64KB pipe-mode output buffer to further reduce write syscalls
asi.rollback_reason: Regression. 64KB output + 32KB stack_buf = 96KB total, exceeds L1 data cache (64KB on Apple Silicon). 32KB was the sweet spot.

description: 16KB pipeline stack + 32KB output - worse than 32KB+32KB

asi.hypothesis: Reduce pipeline stack buf to 16KB (freeing L1 for 32KB output buf)
asi.rollback_reason: Worse. The 32KB stack buffer avoids heap allocation for 16-32KB inputs, which is a bigger win than freeing L1 cache space.

description: Hybrid indexOf git_log.applyCompact - worse, line-by-line is faster

asi.hypothesis: Hybrid indexOf-based git_log.applyCompact: jump between commit markers using indexOf, scan forward for subject line-by-line
asi.rollback_reason: Worse. indexOf scans all bytes (including body text) looking for newline+commit. The simple line-by-line continue after subject_emitted is faster because it only checks one byte per line.

description: Skip toSlice + defer declarations - regression from stack layout

asi.hypothesis: Skip toSlice in pipe mode by checking args.vector.len directly. Also defer environ/stderr/args to wrapper path.
asi.rollback_reason: Regression from 13.9K to 15.2-15.9K. Moving declarations changes stack layout/alignment, which matters more than saving the toSlice call. The arena toSlice is already very cheap.

description: Defer toSlice (minimal) - still regresses from code layout

asi.hypothesis: Minimal: replace toSlice with vector.len for pipe-mode argc check, defer toSlice to wrapper path
asi.rollback_reason: Still 15K vs 13.9K baseline. The vector.len sentinel scan + code layout change regresses. toSlice on arena is essentially free.

description: Confirmed optimized state: 13,439µs, throughput at 2.7 GB/s effective

asi.hypothesis: Confirmed noise floor. Processing overhead is ~0.9ms across 5 tests (2.5MB input). Startup (~12.5ms) is irreducible. No further pipe-mode optimization can meaningfully improve the metric.
asi.note: Best single run: 13,368µs. Typical range: 13.4-14.5K. Throughput at 2.7 GB/s effective after startup.

description: 1MB pipeline pre-alloc - regression, over-allocation hurts

asi.hypothesis: 1MB pipeline pre-alloc to avoid growth+copy for 500KB+ inputs
asi.rollback_reason: Regression. page_allocator maps real pages on alloc. 1MB upfront is expensive for 253-260KB inputs that don't need it. 256KB was the right balance.

description: 512KB pipeline pre-alloc - within noise

asi.hypothesis: 512KB pipeline pre-alloc
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise of 256KB. The doubling cost is negligible compared to startup overhead.

description: Session 5 final: 14,887µs. 45 experiments, pipe-mode exhausted.

asi.hypothesis: Final session 5 confirmation. Noise band: 13.4-15.7K. Processing overhead: ~0.9ms for 2.5MB. 45 experiments run, 10 kept. No further pipe-mode optimization is possible — startup dominates.

description: Fix git_merge 'up to date' handling + tighten npm_install cross-line false positive

asi.hypothesis: Fix git_merge 'Already up to date' handling + tighten npm_install false positive
asi.key_finding: git_merge.apply() now handles 'Already up to date' → 'up to date'. npm_install matcher now requires 'up to date' on same line as 'packages'/'audited' to avoid cross-line false positives.
asi.false_positive_fixed: npm_install matching generic text with 'up to date' + 'packages' on different lines

description: Generic compact fallback for unknown git subcommands in wrapper mode

asi.hypothesis: Add generic_compact fallback for unknown git subcommands in wrapper mode
asi.key_finding: Unknown git subcommands (reflog, shortlog, etc.) now get generic_compact when output >8KB. Pipe benchmark unchanged since it doesn't test wrapper mode.

description: Lower generic_compact threshold 8KB→4KB for medium output compression

asi.hypothesis: Lower generic_compact threshold from 8KB to 4KB
asi.key_finding: No benchmark change (no fixtures in 4-8KB range unmatched by specialized filters). But real-world improvement: medium unknown command outputs now compressed. All tests pass with updated threshold test.

description: Confirmation run: stable at 26606B (97%). Pipeline mature.

asi.hypothesis: Final verification run — no changes, confirming stability
asi.session_summary: Session 3 explored: 4KB threshold (keep), block-pattern improvements (not needed), wrapper-mode investigation (complete). Pipeline is mature at 97% savings.

description: Generic compact: lower block-pattern repeat threshold 5→3

asi.hypothesis: Lower block-pattern repeat threshold from 5 to 3 in generic_compact
asi.key_finding: No benchmark change. Existing fixtures already maximally compressed by line RLE. But more aggressive block detection helps real-world multi-line repeated patterns (log blocks, config sections).

description: Revert dedup threshold 2→3: no effect

asi.hypothesis: Lower global dedup threshold from 3 to 2 in generic_compact
asi.rollback_reason: No effect on any fixture. Bodies appearing 2x are already caught by consecutive-line RLE.

description: Truncate git_diff hunk context to 30 chars: 26345B (-261B)

asi.hypothesis: Truncate hunk header function context to 30 chars in git_diff (used by git_show too)
asi.key_finding: Saved 261B (26606→26345). Function names still identifiable: 'fn xenon_brink_step_5(seed: u' vs full 'fn xenon_brink_step_5(seed: u64) -> u64 {'. Agents don't need the full signature for location context.
